criteria.observation: Fresh transfers preserve total integer units and unrelated accounts; the final balances remain correct across replay and rejection.
The returned statuses, reasons, result shape and required state identity distinguish exact replay, conflicts and defined validation rejections.
Only committed unique transfers append to the request registry and audit, with correct sequence and before/after data. Earlier entries survive.
The caller’s earlier state, request and history remain unchanged after later calls, including rejected ones.

The reported input sequence, before-values and actual observations reproduce and distinguish a change that corrupts an earlier state despite matching final balances. A missing execution record is unobserved.
